data.title: Syria Condemns Houthi Militia Attacks on Saudi Arabia
data.content:
Damascus, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The Syrian Arab Republic has strongly condemned the missile and drone attacks carried out by the Houthi militia targeting several sites and vital facilities in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, which resulted in material damage.
    In a statement, the Syrian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates affirmed that these attacks constitute a violation of the Kingdom's sovereignty, a threat to its security and stability, and a dangerous escalation that jeopardizes the security and safety of the entire region, reiterating Syria's rejection of any actions that undermine the Kingdom's security or threaten the integrity of its territory and assets.
    The ministry expressed Syria's full solidarity with the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and affirmed its support in the face of any threats to its security and stability, emphasizing that the security of the Kingdom is an integral part of regional security and stability and reiterating its support for all measures taken by the Kingdom to protect its sovereignty and safeguard its citizens and residents.
    -- SPA
